purpose: A score-blind, batch-8 transport successor bound to the permanently failed v2 batch-16 pilot. GPT-5.6 Sol remains the primary condition.

failed_v2.source: The caller supplies the exact immutable v2 work root; its required commitments below identify it without recording a machine-specific path.
failed_v2.failure: The first v2 batch-16 cell exhausted its sole logical request after provider HTTP 524 failures. This closes v2 permanently.

transport_pilot.success_rule: Exactly three independent schema-valid provider completions, sequentially, each with one logical provider request, zero recovered retryable failures, distinct bridge sessions, valid raw bridge evidence, and duration below 100 seconds.
transport_pilot.failure_rule: Any failure permanently closes v3. No automatic size step, Nous Pro, DSPy, paid route, or new-human route follows.

development.comparison_rule: Any full-development result is unmatched to primary batch-32 and v2 batch-16 unless separately frozen paired cells exist.

privacy.pilot: No HANNA ratings, correlations, scores, or prose-derived public analysis are produced during the pilot.
privacy.human_judging: Uses only existing HANNA material; no new human judging or contact.
privacy.remote: Nous receives only the authorized per-cell judge input in the external work directory; no private repository content is sent.

interpretation_limits: This route supplements and never replaces GPT-5.6 Sol.
The v2 failure does not promote Nous Pro.
No DSPy prompt optimization is part of v3.
